items.title: Tommy Ridgley Interview, 1986-04-23
items.q: I got to really know Joe Ruffino as a person he was nice man

ctx.x: um okay Joe you know I got so I got very close to Joe you know because he was very much a down-to-earth

type of person where we go in the studio I go there and said I mean Joe talked for hours you know in other words I got to really know Joe Ruffino as a person he was nice man he just didn't pay us but he was not you know we talked and uh I learned too that he had two sets of books now I learned this from his secretary because she said I used to tell Joe all the time that he had one set of books he would show y'all and the other set of books he kept for I guess for Uncle Sam or whatever but uh now on on in the same…
